parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json;if(typeof x.contact_id!=='string'||!x.contact_id.trim()||x.contact_id.length>128||x.contact_id==='OWNER'||x.contact_id.startsWith('CONFIGURE_')||!['briefing','draft'].includes(x.purpose))throw new Error('Configure an explicit contact ID and briefing or draft purpose before retrieval');if(x.deliver_to_owner!==undefined&&typeof x.deliver_to_owner!=='boolean')throw new Error('Owner delivery must be an explicit boolean');const deliver=x.deliver_to_owner===true;if(deliver&&(typeof x.owner_chat_id!=='string'||! /^[1-9]\d{0,15}$/.test(x.owner_chat_id)||x.owner_chat_id!==x.owner_user_id))throw new Error('Configure the same enrolled private owner user and chat');return [{json:{contact_id:x.contact_id,purpose:x.purpose,deliver_to_owner:deliver,owner_chat_id:x.owner_chat_id,owner_user_id:x.owner_user_id,started_at:Date.now()}}];

parameters.jsCode: const raw=$input.first().json;const wrapped=Object.hasOwn(raw,'result');if(!wrapped&&Object.hasOwn(raw,'ok'))throw new Error('Incomplete owner transport envelope; inspect delivery before any manual retry');if(wrapped&&(raw.ok!==true||!raw.result||typeof raw.result!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw.result)))throw new Error('Invalid owner transport envelope; inspect delivery before any manual retry');const x=wrapped?raw.result:raw;const c=$('Validate explicit private AI selection').first().json;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(x.message_id)||x.message_id<=0||!x.chat||x.chat.type!=='private'||String(x.chat.id)!==c.owner_chat_id)throw new Error('Owner transport acknowledgement unavailable or mismatched; inspect delivery before any manual retry');return [{json:{...$('Return review only without delivery').first().json,owner_delivery:{status:'sent',message_id:x.message_id}}}];
